note: Hawaii Office of Elections final report records the decisive Honolulu mayoral contest (special mayoral vacancy election) on 2010-09-18. Winner and runner-up are in honolulu_results.json.

The Hawaii Office of Elections results index lists election results only for even-numbered years in this period, apart from the 2010 special congressional election. The city clerk list of mayors shows four-year terms (Carlisle 2010-2013, Caldwell 2013-2021, Blangiardi 2021-2029), so no mayoral election fell in this year.
